units: Kil. VIII, 6 ע׳ מין חיה the ʿarod belongs to the class of beasts of chase (v. חַיָּה I).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3a:3">R. Hash. 3ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ערד</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 21:1">Num. XXI, 1</cite>) <he>שדומה לע׳ במדבר</he> for he (Sihon) was like a wild ass in the desert; a. e.—Pl. <he>עֲרוֹדוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 8:1:2">Y. Shek. VIII, beg. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ היו נוחרין</he> (<he>לאריות</he>) <he>וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., p. 67ᵃ, note 70) in the royal arena in Jerusalem they stabbed wild asses (for the lions), and the pilgrims waded in blood; <cite ref="Menachot 103b:20">Men. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>עֲרוֹדִיאוֹת</he> (Mb. M. <he>עדראות</he>; Ms. C. <he>ערדאות</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Eduyot 3:2">Tosef. Eduy. III, 2</cite> <he>עֲרָרוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00166"><he>עֵדֶר</he></cite>).
